label: miso2 importnode
definition: (PROBE) Adds the forecast-grade reference-price interchange node for MISO (Module M4): PJM/SPP/SERC-South seams, each priced from the neighbor's own gas x heat-rate x EIA-930 load shape (HR 12.3/10.0/12.0; cited interface limits 7.3/4.0/3.0 GW), the LP clearing volume on the spread vs MISO's own LMP. Default-on for MISO via REFERENCE_PRICE_DEFAULT_ISOS; PJM opt-in, ERCOT byte-identical. Also corrected HENRY_HUB_TRAJECTORIES[2025] 2.88->3.52 (actual). Determination NOT-YET: the node is structurally correct and measured-anchored, but MISO's modeled LMP is too low (-6/-14/-13%, pre-existing offer-curve level miss), so fed correctly-priced neighbors the seam EXPORTS MISO's over-cheap energy rather than importing -- net interchange does not reach EIA-930 (model NI +0.1/-7.5/+45.0 vs actual -37.9/-23.1/-19.0 TWh; 2024 imports modestly, 2025 over-exports). Root cause for next pass: MISO price level + the absent firm-hydro (Manitoba) import that a gas-margin seam cannot represent. Mechanism stays in (CLAUDE.md #1); seam not tuned to the net-MWh target (#12).
